observation.visible_scene: Close-up of a stainless-steel box grater held at a diagonal: the perforated side faces the right of frame, while the central grating surface is coated with fine orange shreds. A person's hand enters from the top, pinching a small orange food piece (consistent with a carrot) and pressing it against the grating surface. The background is a blurred maroon/purple fabric. The grater and background keep a constant orientation throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The hand repeatedly rubs the orange piece up and down along the grater's surface in short back-and-forth strokes; the piece's position relative to the grater shifts between the upper and middle part of the grating area across the frames.

Around the middle of the clip (frames ~12-14) the orange piece is lifted out of view, leaving only the hand and the shred-covered grater, then it is brought back into contact with the surface (frame ~15 onward) and the rubbing resumes.
The orange shreds already stuck in the grater's holes remain visible and largely undisturbed during the strokes; no clear large-scale buildup or clearing of shreds is evident within this window.
The hand's grip and the piece's orientation change slightly as it is repositioned for each stroke.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the grating action began before or continues after this cropped segment.
The total size of the orange piece and how much of it has been grated overall.
What collects the shreds (the bowl/surface below the grater is never shown).
uncertain_details: Material identity of the orange piece and shreds (carrot is the most likely interpretation but not directly confirmed).
Whether the camera is completely static or has very slight motion; the fixed grater/background orientation suggests a mostly locked shot, but this cannot be fully verified.
Exact degree of shred accumulation versus mere redistribution on the grater surface.
